note: Registry of research experiments surfaced on the dashboard. Numbers are read from the raw result files named in `results`; the verdict text here is the human decision record and must match the referenced report.

experiments.title: Gate A kill test — does pixel-level CRC leave lesions unprotected?
experiments.pre_registered_statistic: G = R_les(lambda_pix) / alpha on the full calibration split; KILL <= 1.1, INCONCLUSIVE (1.1, 1.5), PROCEED >= 1.5 with n_cal >= 100 and K3 passing
experiments.recommendation_reason: K3 fails (4.9% multi-lesion frames). On 95% single large lesions at tau=0.5 a population-average G<1 is guaranteed by construction, not by the hypothesis being false. Post-hoc stratification (not pre-registered) shows G|K>=2 of 1.3-3.1 on ~14 multi-polyp frames per seed and ~40% of small lesions missed — the hypothesis's direction where its precondition holds, on too few units to count.
experiments.next: Move Gate A to W3 (FracAtlas at 512 px) and W6 (MSD Task08); pre-register G on the K>=2 subpopulation with n>=100.

experiments.title: FracAtlas K3 data audit (gap test deliberately not run)
experiments.pre_registered_statistic: K3 only: multi-lesion fraction, small-lesion tail, n_cal, mask quality by eye
experiments.recommendation: PROCEED to W3 gap test on this dataset
experiments.recommendation_reason: 719 fractured images, 924 polygons; K>=2 in 23.8% (vs 4.9% on Kvasir); 93.9% of components below 1% of image area. Masks are coarse region polygons, not fracture-line delineations. 74% of images are 373x454 so the 256 px resize does NOT erase them (median annotation 142 px at 256; 0% below 10 px) -- a correction to the pre-audit assumption. No patient id; `multiscan` flag only. ~50 multi-lesion units per calibration split: below the n>=100 subpopulation bar, so Task08 is still needed for a decisive result.
experiments.next: W3: COCO-polygon loader, per-dataset working size (384-512), retrain RF on the train split, run the corrected pre-registration (G on the K>=2 subpopulation).

protocol.min_lesion_px: to be chosen from this dataset's histogram before its gap test

experiments.title: Hippocampus smoke test (execution check, not a lesion task)
experiments.recommendation_reason: Single structure: anterior and posterior touch in every slice, so merged foreground is one component. G = 0.11-0.26 is the correct output of tau=0.5 on one large structure, not a labelling error (verified against brute force, max diff 0.0).
